mandatory_facts.proposition: Views store user's columns, sort and filters per dashboard, never row data; team sharing, public links and restore are deferred
At most five views; names trimmed, 1..40 Unicode scalar values, case-insensitively unique per user per dashboard; same name on different dashboards allowed
Successful server response required before save/rename success; sixth/duplicate attempts preserve existing views and show actionable error
Unknown/inaccessible load reveals no saved fields, returns default dashboard with explanation; other users cannot list/load/rename/delete owned views
Sign-out clears client view cache; default dashboards remain usable without saved views
Network failure during save/rename retains editor contents and offers retry without success toast; deleting one view must leave siblings intact; keyboard access needs actual validation

Historical E-8 API passes: create/load fields round-trip, trimmed/case-normalized duplicate rejection, sixth rejection preserving five, cross-user list/load denial; do not claim other scenarios passed

scenario_evaluation: Each required scenario must have feasible preconditions, an action and a source-consistent observable outcome. Multiple closely related scenarios may share a row if each remains explicit. Do not require one row per fact. Boundary names should test empty/overlong values, with 40 accepted and 41 rejected if numeric examples are given. No endpoint or HTTP-code invention is necessary.
